ABOUT SEALPROOF

A family-run business.
A practical pair of hands.

Based in South East London, helping homeowners and businesses with repairs, maintenance and improvements.

From SealProof’s Yell gallery ↗

From one person to a wider team

Built around the work
your property needs.

SealProof began as a one-person business and grew to include kitchen and bathroom fitters, electricians and maintenance engineers.

The work ranges from everyday repairs and general property maintenance to full kitchen and bathroom installations, serving both residential and commercial customers.

The aim is straightforward: do it right, do it once.

See the full range of services ↗

Local base. Wider reach.

South East London,
London & Kent.

SealProof serves London, Kent and surrounding counties. Contact the team to check your location and discuss the work.

Free quotations and appointments to discuss requirements
Special discounts for pensioners. Ask when enquiring.
24-hour emergency call-out service. Call to confirm availability.
